annotations.title: Rank all US public companies by a financial metric (SEC XBRL frames)

description: Rank all US public companies by a financial metric (SEC XBRL frames) — One value per SEC filer for a calendar year or quarter: revenue, net income, operating income, operating cash flow, R&D, EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash or long-term debt (or any us-gaap tag). Returns top/bottom N, company count, median, total, and optional rank + percentile for one ticker. Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). JSON. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

concept.description: optional raw us-gaap tag instead of metric

symbol.description: optional ticker to rank, e.g. AAPL

name: sec_frames
